title: So You Want to Launch a Newsletter: Tips From Substack Writers

reader_summary.headline: Hi, and welcome to the A16C podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hi, and welcome to the A16C podcast. Today's episode, part one in a two-part series about the creator economy, explores the process and economics behind creating an independent newsletter. An artist, a technologist, a journalist, and a clinical researcher turned psychedelics scholar.

key_points.text: The pandemic has prompted a reckoning within traditional media, and alongside it, a surge in the newsletter ecosystem.
key_points.evidence_quote: The pandemic has prompted a reckoning within traditional media, and alongside it, a surge in the newsletter ecosystem.

key_points.text: This episode reveals the behind-the-scenes experiences of four newsletter creators, all of whom launched roughly within the past year.
key_points.evidence_quote: This episode reveals the behind-the-scenes experiences of four newsletter creators, all of whom launched roughly within the past year.

key_points.text: Software engineer Lenny Richitsky, most recently a growth product manager at Airbnb, whose tech-focused dispatch is called Lenny's newsletter, more on that later.
key_points.evidence_quote: Software engineer Lenny Richitsky, most recently a growth product manager at Airbnb, whose tech-focused dispatch is called Lenny's newsletter, more on that later, artist and writer Edith Zimmerman, creator, creator of of the drawing links newsletter, which chronicles her life and musings through comic-style illustrations.

key_points.text: Zach Hegney, an acupuncturist and researcher whose newsletter, The Trip Report, explores the science, policy, and business behind medicinal psychedelics.
key_points.evidence_quote: Zach Hegney, an acupuncturist and researcher whose newsletter, The Trip Report, explores the science, policy, and business behind medicinal psychedelics.

thesis: The episode explores the process and economics of launching independent newsletters, featuring four creators from diverse backgrounds who launched within the past year. The discussion covers motivations for starting newsletters, the decision between paid and unpaid models, and financial benchmarks for making a living from writing.
